name: WMUISwipeDeck
description: Card deck with pan physics and a stacked rest state. Drag the top card past the threshold to accept or reject it. Built directly on Gesture Handler and Reanimated, both of which support web, so the deck runs on iOS, Android and web. The page must sit inside a GestureHandlerRootView.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: Cards to render. Each row may carry a title, a subtitle and an image URL. Example: [{title: 'Ada Lovelace', subtitle: 'Mathematician', image: '...'}]

titleField.name: titleField
titleField.description: Row field shown as the card title. Default: title

subtitleField.name: subtitleField
subtitleField.description: Row field shown under the title. Default: subtitle

imageField.name: imageField
imageField.description: Row field holding the card image URL. Default: image

imageHeight.name: imageHeight
imageHeight.description: Height in pixels of the image band at the top of each card. Default: 180

stackOffset.name: stackOffset
stackOffset.description: Pixels each card behind the top one is offset by, producing the stack. Default: 12

stackDepth.name: stackDepth
stackDepth.description: How many cards are drawn behind the top card. Default: 2

swipeThreshold.name: swipeThreshold
swipeThreshold.description: Horizontal drag distance in pixels that commits a swipe. Below it the card springs back. Default: 120

enabled.name: enabled
enabled.description: Whether dragging is accepted. Set false to freeze the deck. Default: true

onSwipeRight.name: onSwipeRight
onSwipeRight.description: Fires with the card swiped right, the accept gesture.

onSwipeLeft.name: onSwipeLeft
onSwipeLeft.description: Fires with the card swiped left, the reject gesture.

onDeckEmpty.name: onDeckEmpty
onDeckEmpty.description: Fires once, after the last card leaves the deck.
